sermon.title: Revival, Ground Zero - January 28, 2024
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: A walk through revival in Scripture: the spiritually dead made alive, Lazarus called out, the contrite revived, Jacob revived from pain, and the woman who pressed in to touch Jesus. Revival comes through the word, praise and repentance. It must be genuine, not used to promote a man, and God still visits individuals and families while we wait for Him to visit the vine.
